module.name: holoscan-icp
module.description: Point-cloud registration on the GPU with iterative closest point: point-to-point and point-to-plane, with nearest neighbors in a sorted uniform grid, normals estimated on the GPU, CUB reductions, coarse-to-fine correspondence distances, voxel subsampling and Huber or Tukey weights. IcpOp aligns pairs of clouds, clouds to a stored map, or each cloud to the one before as depth odometry; the results are deterministic.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
